scope: Read-only portability, dependency, provenance and preservation audit of the original v109 walkable study. This record preserves already completed observations; it does not report a rerun of the 27 headless or 74 asset checks, a Godot import, native visual acceptance, or a fresh verification of the archive copy.
result: The original runtime resource set is complete and uses project-relative paths. A portable archive needs self-contained asset-verification expectations, font licensing, corrected environment credits, and an explicit first-import prerequisite.

runtime_dependencies.resource_resolution: Runtime scripts use res:// resources within the independent project. Environment images resolve from assets/environment plus the manifest image field. run.sh resolves its project root from its own location.
runtime_dependencies.coordinate_contract: Runtime uses original screen_pixel collision points, foot_screen_pixel anchors and sprite_offset_pixel offsets at identity screen-pixel scale, without applying the manifest camera_zoom conversion.
runtime_dependencies.layout_limitation: Original prop occlusion and lighting are baked. Original props cannot be freely moved or removed while claiming the same composition or lighting.
runtime_dependencies.character_contract: Eight static idle direction regions from the unchanged hero atlas; no animated walk or run frames or animation acceptance.

completed_static_integrity_observation.meaning: A one-time read-only SHA-256 comparison of the inspected original source files matched all 35 saved input expectations. No image regeneration or executable test suite was run for this observation.
completed_static_integrity_observation.coverage_limit: The 35-entry input manifest covers asset and provenance inputs, not all project scripts or the later archive copy.
completed_static_integrity_observation.preservation_method: Use ordinary independent-project files. Byte-identical copies can share Git blobs without symlinks.

existing_test_evidence.interpretation: Retain these as original completed-test evidence. Keep later native observations, archive checks or retests in separate records rather than rewriting the original handoff or claiming new execution.

verify_study_gd.input: preload res://study.gd; all tested scene resources come from the independent project
verify_study_gd.side_effect: The script replaces qa/headless-verification.json when run. Its saved historical report should be protected by using a disposable checkout or a separate result destination.

original_verify_assets_py.recommended_portable_change: Compare runtime inputs with frozen original SHA-256 expectations; accept original source directories only as an optional extra comparison. Preserve the previously executed test source separately and do not label the changed wrapper as already rerun.

run_sh.first_import_guidance: Open the independent project.godot in the Godot 4.6.3 editor and allow resource import to finish before running a fresh cache-free checkout. A documented optional CLI equivalent is godot --headless --editor --path PROJECT_DIRECTORY --import.
run_sh.windows_guidance: Open project.godot directly in Godot. The Bash launcher is optional and is not a Windows-native launcher.
run_sh.cache_policy: Retain source .import files and .gd.uid files; omit .godot and .runtime-home. The engine reconstructs cache outputs from source assets and import settings.

provenance_findings.original_credit_issue: The original v109 copy still credits Grass Bermuda 01 to Rico Cilliers and Rob Tuytel. The inspected fc2cdbb v108 archive already corrects this to Rico Cilliers.
provenance_findings.license_scope: Poly Haven asset records state CC0. The font has its separate SIL OFL license; the generated character provenance is separate. Do not label the entire project CC0.
provenance_findings.original_download_audit_reference: The original SOURCES.md refers to asset-download-audit.json, which was not present beside it in the inspected v109 source. Include the small audit or provide an explicit, working reference to the baseline record.
provenance_findings.historical_hash_handling: The original 35-entry input manifest includes the original SOURCES.md hash. Preserve that evidence unchanged when adopting corrected credits; record corrected provenance files and all delivered files in a separate archive manifest and source mapping.

archive_work_reported_by_parent_not_inde.verification_status: Parent-reported completion only; not an additional audit finding. No rescanning or test rerun was performed while writing this record.
